sport-gloves-superconductor.name: ★ Sport Gloves | Superconductor
sport-gloves-superconductor.desc:
Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching. The blue and black gloves are ideal for those who wish to be phenomenal.

They don't want none

broken-fang-gloves-needle-point.name: ★ Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point
broken-fang-gloves-needle-point.desc: These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Broken Fang logo.

ak-47-green-laminate.name: AK-47 | Green Laminate
ak-47-green-laminate.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. An green laminate has been applied to this AK's stock, grip, and handguard.

It's the simple things

aug-momentum.name: AUG | Momentum
aug-momentum.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been custom painted with bright colors and forward facing arrows.

Always moving forward

aug-triqua.name: AUG | Triqua
aug-triqua.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. A custom paint job with gunmetal triangles and carbon fiber over a burnt orange base.

All things being equal

aug-wings.name: AUG | Wings
aug-wings.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been decorated with dry-transfer decals of eagle feathers.

An eagle looks majestic until it's clawing your eyes out

awp-lightning-strike.name: AWP | Lightning Strike
awp-lightning-strike.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been painted with a lightning strike motif using anodizing effect paints over a metallic base coat.

Sometimes you don't need to strike the same place twice

awp-crakow.name: AWP | Crakow!
awp-crakow.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted using whimsical, playground-style art depicting a little girl and her robot.

Playing make believe

bayonet-doppler-ruby.name: ★ Bayonet | Doppler
bayonet-doppler-ruby.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

pp-bizon-wood-block-camo.name: PP-Bizon | Wood Block Camo
pp-bizon-wood-block-camo.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. A grey and maroon woodgrain pattern has been applied.

Re-staining is recommended every 3 to 4 years

cz75-auto-copper-fiber.name: CZ75-Auto | Copper Fiber
cz75-auto-copper-fiber.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been painted using a copper-colored carbon fiber hydrographic.

"Try saying THAT three times fast..."

cz75-auto-nitro.name: CZ75-Auto | Nitro
cz75-auto-nitro.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has individual parts spray-painted black and tangerine orange.

Rona is as good as she thinks she is... she's just not old enough to realize she shouldn't point it out to everyone - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

desert-eagle-heirloom.name: Desert Eagle | Heirloom
desert-eagle-heirloom.desc: As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been hand engraved and inlaid with a scroll pattern.

desert-eagle-mecha-industries.name: Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries
desert-eagle-mecha-industries.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. Its white and black design feels both sterile and futuristic.

Same technology, now available in a smaller form factor

galil-ar-varicamo.name: Galil AR | VariCamo
galil-ar-varicamo.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

glock-18-brass.name: Glock-18 | Brass
glock-18-brass.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. Parts of the weapon have been replaced with brass.

Fool's gold

glock-18-neo-noir.name: Glock-18 | Neo-Noir
glock-18-neo-noir.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been custom painted with a stylized blue-magenta woman over a grayscale background.

"Things were starting to turn and she began to feel hope—then she looked up"

glock-18-ifrit-lattice.name: Glock-18 | Ifrit Lattice
glock-18-ifrit-lattice.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been custom painted with a tan and black design.

Outdated intel is still intel, ya know...

p2000-coral-halftone.name: P2000 | Coral Halftone
p2000-coral-halftone.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been custom painted using a multicolored halftone pattern.

Watch your tone

survival-knife-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Survival Knife | Doppler
survival-knife-doppler-phase-4.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

flip-knife-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Flip Knife | Doppler
flip-knife-doppler-phase-3.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

flip-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Flip Knife | Gamma Doppler
flip-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-3.desc: Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

flip-knife-marble-fade.name: ★ Flip Knife | Marble Fade
flip-knife-marble-fade.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

gut-knife-boreal-forest.name: ★ Gut Knife | Boreal Forest
gut-knife-boreal-forest.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

navaja-knife-urban-masked.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Urban Masked
navaja-knife-urban-masked.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

nomad-knife-urban-masked.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Urban Masked
nomad-knife-urban-masked.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

shadow-daggers-doppler-ruby.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Doppler
shadow-daggers-doppler-ruby.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

bowie-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Gamma Doppler
bowie-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-2.desc: This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

bowie-knife-slaughter.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Slaughter
bowie-knife-slaughter.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

huntsman-knife-doppler-black-pearl.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Doppler
huntsman-knife-doppler-black-pearl.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

huntsman-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler
huntsman-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-4.desc: A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

ursus-knife-boreal-forest.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Boreal Forest
ursus-knife-boreal-forest.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

m4a4-daybreak.name: M4A4 | Daybreak
m4a4-daybreak.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been painted with a sunrise in metallic paints.

The sun rises on the just and unjust alike

m4a4-global-offensive.name: M4A4 | Global Offensive
m4a4-global-offensive.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted with a blue, yellow, and grey camoflauge.

"We'll make first contact in Harz, Germany at 17:25 GMT+1..."

mp5-sd-gauss.name: MP5-SD | Gauss
mp5-sd-gauss.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. It has been custom painted to look like it was assembled from pieces of stamped steel.

Lovingly referred to as the "SpaceGat 2000"

mp5-sd-snow-splash.name: MP5-SD | Snow Splash
mp5-sd-snow-splash.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. A grayscale pattern featuring sharp, angular designs has been applied.

Unflinching

mp7-abyssal-apparition.name: MP7 | Abyssal Apparition
mp7-abyssal-apparition.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. This custom paint job depicts abandoned souls falling into a pit of nightmares.

You cannot escape your destiny

mp9-capillary.name: MP9 | Capillary
mp9-capillary.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. A custom paint job comprised of intricate teal and coral veins has been applied.

857 bpm

mp9-modest-threat.name: MP9 | Modest Threat
mp9-modest-threat.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been hand painted with an orange and black design.

Be the last 01 standing

mp9-dune-asp.name: MP9 | Dune Asp
mp9-dune-asp.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. A snake has been custom painted with white calligraphy-style strokes over a tan-colored base.

An unusual artifact from a barren world

mp9-orange-peel.name: MP9 | Orange Peel
mp9-orange-peel.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

p90-emerald-dragon.name: P90 | Emerald Dragon
p90-emerald-dragon.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. This memento from Chinatown has been painted with a dragon motif.

Tradition can be dangerous

p90-run-and-hide.name: P90 | Run and Hide
p90-run-and-hide.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been custom painted with a jaguar pattern and finished with pebbled leather.

Anyone can buy their way into fashion, but very few possess true style

p90-elite-build.name: P90 | Elite Build
p90-elite-build.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been custom painted using a combination of hydrographics and careful stenciling and detailed with heat-transfer decals.

Tread softly Naomi...people in your line of work aren't known for their longevity - The Shield and The Serpent Part 2

p90-aeolian-light.name: P90 | Aeolian Light
p90-aeolian-light.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. A grayscale, abstract knot pattern has been applied.

Let the wind carry you

p90-wave-breaker.name: P90 | Wave Breaker
p90-wave-breaker.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been custom painted using an angular blue and green design.

You look how you feel

sg-553-anodized-navy.name: SG 553 | Anodized Navy
sg-553-anodized-navy.desc: The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent navy blue anodized effect paint.

sg-553-triarch.name: SG 553 | Triarch
sg-553-triarch.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. This rifle was commissioned by royalty and given custom desert camo.

Remind them of your love

sg-553-ultraviolet.name: SG 553 | Ultraviolet
sg-553-ultraviolet.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

sg-553-gator-mesh.name: SG 553 | Gator Mesh
sg-553-gator-mesh.desc: The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been spray-painted freehand using mesh fabric as a stencil.

ssg-08-death-strike.name: SSG 08 | Death Strike
ssg-08-death-strike.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. Sand streams over an emperor scorpion on this custom painted SSG 08.

That's gonna sting...

ssg-08-sea-calico.name: SSG 08 | Sea Calico
ssg-08-sea-calico.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. A yellow floral pattern has been applied over a dark teal base.

You won't need flowers when you're dead

tec-9-avalanche.name: Tec-9 | Avalanche
tec-9-avalanche.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been custom painted with a sleek and futuristic hydrographic.

We must be smart how we move against her, one wrong move and she'll come crashing down on both of us - The Serpent and the Truth Seeker

tec-9-orange-murano.name: Tec-9 | Orange Murano
tec-9-orange-murano.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. An orange hydrographic of Murano beads has been applied.

Death by a thousand beads

tec-9-rust-leaf.name: Tec-9 | Rust Leaf
tec-9-rust-leaf.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been spray-painted with an orange pattern of overlapping leaves.

Blood on the leaves

tec-9-army-mesh.name: Tec-9 | Army Mesh
tec-9-army-mesh.desc: An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been spray-painted freehand using mesh fabric as a stencil.

ump-45-wild-child.name: UMP-45 | Wild Child
ump-45-wild-child.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. Beneath sketches of bullets, a crown, and other designs, bands of neon color are the base of this custom painted UMP-45.

The concept is simple, it's the execution that's difficult

xm1014-xoxo.name: XM1014 | XOXO
xm1014-xoxo.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. A vividly colored, punk-inspired pattern has been applied.

Yeah, right…

xm1014-canvas-cloud.name: XM1014 | Canvas Cloud
xm1014-canvas-cloud.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. A pattern of orange, tan, and brown spots has been applied.

Spotty coverage
